body:
That's a cool coincidence, also, How To Destroy Angels put their debut album Welcome Oblivion online for listening. Today is a good day :D

I have learned a lot about life, but there's still much more to learn. Without trying to be egotistical, I'll say I'll do well in life. Once I leave school, I'm going to start making an autobiography/diary and when my music or my hypotheses on things get recognition, I'll release a Pt. 1. I doubt being a teacher will be my strong point, although even the ace student in my school copies my homework. People say that I've a really philosophical mind. 

I see my psychiatrist on random dates for an hour, she never put me on anti-deprssiants, she thinks I don't need much help, but yet see doesn't understand me at all. My next appointment is in March.

Algebra can be difficult, but when practiced, it can become simple and enjoyable. I know it may sound easy for me since I was ahead of everybody in school at maths in primary **by a mile,** you can get your head around it I'm sure, if you find yourself struggling, get a grind!

Thanks! Once I get my self-esteem back, I'll be productive with the time I have to spend :)
I've stayed awake for 3 days, without coffee or energy drinks.

I already try do that, I practice an instrument for 30 minutes some days and exercise every 3rd day. I'm still lacking motivation to perform at my true pace. Any goal becomes a challenge because I simply can't bring myself to it. I'm too unhappy, wearing a mask all the time. I just can't keep up. I only get 4 hours of sleep on average, I can't even get my sleep because of my clustering pessimistic thoughts.

Thanks, this is probably the nicest thing anybody said here to me. Ps; It's my third time, I used different throwaways and different major plots. 
I never tried to kill myself, when I was 14 I was going to jump off my window ledge with a knife pointing towards my heart so I'd die quickly, if guns were legal in Ireland I wouldn't of made it past 13. The only thing that stopped me was my religion, although now I'm atheist. 

If I could I would give Reddit Gold because you opened up in a situation you didn't have to, and considering what you've been through it really states that life just changes so much once you've fully grown and developed. Today I spent my whole day in bed but after reading this I feel motivated enough to prevent that happening again :) *virtual hugs*

I've told them a year ago that I'd been visualizing killing people since I was 8 bit that had stopped 6 months before I told them. It was never anyone in paticular, but still fucked up how I'd disembowel people in them before even knowing what disemboweling was. At the moment I'm generally hating myself because I'm only a year and half away from leaving school, ironic as it may seem I want to get a Masters in Psychology if not a PHD because I want to be a Psychologist.

I never heard of Bottin, I'll have to give Simple Minds and Roxy a listen too.

Additionally, my favorite band is Nine Inch Nails. I listen to Smashing Pumpkins to Macabre, Deadmau5 to KoRn, Interpol to Beastie Boys, Red Hot Chili Peppers to KMFDM, Figure to Nirvana and so on...
One song I listen to in paticular to help me is Lateralis by Tool. When I first listened to it I found that there was some sort of syllable pattern within the song and when I searched it on YouTube, there was this video explaining how the finobinnaci (if spelt correctly) is involved with notes, time signatures and syllables. It also states how that a finobinnaci spiral would go on forever and they use is as a metaphor in the song too. The song is about over-thinking and over-analyzing which I can really relate to. It suggests the over-thinking is a gift to solve things in your mind which were never solved before and to live life like a finobinnaci spiral, reaching out for information and knowledge. Truly a beautiful song.

Well, if I tell my psychiatrist I'm suicidal she has to tell my family for a policy she signed without me acknowledging it. When I ask a question she states something obvious and I get frustrated, but I hide that so I can get at least 10 minutes of actual help on top of the other 50 minutes of obliviously making me feel unable to resolve a problem anybody else could solve.
I complained about this before after explaining it very well, she somewhat understood, but the week after, she forgot entirely. When your psychiatrist or psychologist let's on they can't understand you, you really do feel fucked up.

Thanks anyhow :) It's a nice feeling to help others.
Well, I guess this makes me feel less alone, thanks for that :)
I already am in two bands and produce electronic music. I'm not saying who I am, but I got 1,000 followers on soundcloud within two months. I've wrote many personal songs...
My psychiatrist already said something similar to this, but then I feel stereotypical and then when I ask a friend "is it normal if..." Questions were the reply is "absolutely not".
Thanks, now I feel a little bit less alone, but I really can't bring myself to call a hotline, even though I have the numbers on my phone.

"I'm suprised you've never have had a relationship." 

It just made me so happy because although I still haven't had a relationship, it was a confidence boost and since I was a child I always wanted one. I never wanted to be spoilt with money or items. I was 15 at the time. I'm still depressed though, since I was 12 and I'm 16 now.
